messages:
lisa: Heads up — planning to cut release 2026.03.1 tomorrow 10:00 PST. Drafting the internal release note now, and I need a quick pass on the rollback matrix + pin guidance. @miguel @sam any red flags?

miguel: LGTM on features. Main risk is the new batching change; recommend pinning model runtime to v2.4.1 for at least the first 24h. Will monitor latency.

sam: Agree with pin to v2.4.1. Canary at 5% for 15m, then 25% for 30m if no regressions, then full. If token latency P95 > 600ms or error-rate spikes > 0.8% during canary -> immediate rollback.

lisa: Nice, can we codify that into the ops checklist here? Also need the short internal blurb for the all-hands/ops channel — one-paragraph plain english + TL;DR for oncall.

jacob: Oncall standby: i'll be primary during the window, eva secondary. Rollback decision tree (condensed):
- Immediate rollback if:
  - total 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR
  - P95 latency > 750ms for 3 consecutive 5m buckets OR
  - deploybot returns model mismatch / KV cache errors
- Graceful rollback (stepwise) if:
  - small spike in QPS but errors under thresholds -> scale pools / increase batch size tweak
- Post-rollforward: revert pin after investigations + run regression eval set

eva: For internal announcement, suggest this snippet (please copy/paste):
"""
Internal: Release 2026.03.1 — rolling tomorrow 10:00 PST. This release includes a batching performance improvement and a refined serving kernel for small-context chat. We will roll canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with pins to runtime v2.4.1 for the first 24h. Oncall: jacob (primary), eva (secondary). If you see >0.5% 5xx or P95 token latency >750ms, follow the rollback playbook.
"""
Add this to the internal channel, and mark it as embargoed until 09:45 PST.

deploybot: Scheduled job created: `/deploy release/2026.03.1 --canary 5,25 --staging true --pin runtime:v2.4.1 --notify #eng-releases`

lisa: Perfect — i'll paste eva's blurb into the internal announce at 09:45 PST and set the deploybot job. Quick approvals: @sam thumbs? @miguel thumbs?

sam: :thumbsup:

miguel: :+1: will watch the canary dashboards and post quick notes in this thread.

lisa: Thanks all — final checklist I'm saving in the release doc: 1) paste blurb at 09:45 (internal), 2) deploybot schedule at 10:00, 3) canary checks + rollback thresholds, 4) post-mortem template ready if we need it. I'll pin the doc in #eng-releases when done.
